name: defrr
description: Revenue recognition for contracts, worked out by defrr's engine: schedules, waterfalls, renewals, price corrections, cancellations and usage pricing, in your base currency or a foreign one, including back-dated contracts. With a key that allows it, also saves contracts and renewals to your defrr organization as drafts for a person to approve.

api_key.title: defrr API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://defrr.com/developers/account (40 free credits). Tick 'Save contracts in Defrr' on the key if you want the plugin to save drafts.
